subject: SAME AS clause
notes: kb/Work PB1300. Rule (cite.py --check 13.18.49.4 'If an alphanumeric group item or strongly-typed group item to which data-name-1 is subordinate contains a USAGE clause, the effect is as though that USAGE clause had been specified for the subject of the entry' -> OK §13.18.49.4 3)). ExpandSameAs's ancestor walk now takes a USAGE only from a group whose ItemCategory.GroupKindsOf is Alphanumeric or StronglyTyped, passing over any other kind; GroupKindsOf reads the GROUP-USAGE a group is 'explicitly or implicitly described as' (§13.18.29.3 SR2/SR3) pull-style, so a group nested in a GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL group is a national group already in this first bind pass. Golden: SA SAME AS AE under `01 A USAGE COMP-5` -> BYTE-LENGTH 2 (alphanumeric group transfers); ES SAME AS E under `05 H USAGE NATIONAL` in `01 G GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL` -> 3 (H is a national group; E itself is 6). The GR5 sibling (SIGN, set alphanumeric|national|strongly-typed) takes the same filter.
